boundary_evidence: The Nitro SDK's gx_g3x.c, 0x020553c0..0x02055998, less its first function: 13 functions from 0x02055454. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/GX_g3x.c, compiled with its own pinned mwccarm 1.2/sp2p3, emits 17: GXi_NopClearFifo128_ 0x94, G3X_SetHOffset 0x10, G3X_GetBoxTestResult 0x28, G3X_GetMtxStackLevelPJ 0x2c, G3X_GetMtxStackLevelPV 0x2c, G3X_InitTable 0xa8, G3X_SetClearColor 0x30, G3X_SetFogTable 0x14, G3X_SetEdgeColorTable 0x18, G3X_GetVectorMtx 0x48, G3X_GetClipMtx 0x48, G3X_SetFog 0x54, G3X_ResetMtxStack_2 0xac, G3X_InitMtxStack 0xb0, G3X_ClearFifo 0x34, G3X_ResetMtxStack 0x88, G3X_Init 0x15c. Thirteen land in that order: func_020553c0, func_02055454, func_02055464, func_02055490, func_020554bc (0xb8, drift), SetClearColor, SetFogTable, SetFog, func_02055624, func_020556d0, func_02055780, func_020557b4, func_0205583c, all at pret's sizes except InitTable. GetBoxTestResult, SetEdgeColorTable, GetVectorMtx and GetClipMtx are absent because nothing in this game calls them.

func_020555a4 (0x18, between SetClearColor and SetFogTable) is G3X_SetToonTable: it copies 0x40 bytes to TOON_TABLE 0x4000380. pret's file doesn't have it (Pokemon doesn't link it), so its slot is the one place the order can't be checked against pret.

BOTTOM EDGE: func_020553c0 (0x020553c0..0x02055454) is GXi_NopClearFifo128_, gx_g3x.c's first function, an asm function in pret too. It stays its own source (src/unnamed/arm9/0205/func_020553c0.c) only because port/tools/hostgen.py skips any file holding an asm block, and the port hostgens this file for func_02055780. Below it, func_020553a4 is the last of three 0x1c matrix-command wrappers that begin with Geometry_MatrixMultiply3x3 at 0x0205536c; none of them is in GX_g3x.c.
TOP EDGE: func_02055998 at 0x02055998 begins arm9/G3i (src/engine/gx/G3i.cpp).
No lifecycle or RTTI: G3X has no instance state and no virtuals.
notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from.
The address-named members keep their linker names with C linkage; their SDK names, from pret's GX_g3x.c, are in source comments.

PC port: smoke_gx hostgens func_02055780 by symbol, which emits this whole file; everything else is under #ifndef _MSC_VER because the rest calls SDK code the host build doesn't link. port/ntr/runtime.cpp supplies func_020553c0.
